The command is translated in every supported language. Localized the harbour master’s replies when a captain arrives drunk, including text that wraps across several lines. events.title: Sail controls and smoother shore handling
events.summary: This update applies to the full game and the Mediterranean demo. Set your sails Cycle between full, reefed and furled sails to control how much wind power your ship uses. The default keyboard binding is R; controller prompts follow your bindings, and touch players can double-tap their own ship. The control can be rebound, and the current setting can also be changed in Options. Ships show their deployed sail area and play a short sail-handling sound when you change it. events.title: More reliable controller steering
events.summary: This update applies to the full game and demo. Fixed controller recovery that could discard working Steam Input steering when an unrelated action was unbound. Steering and button recovery now remain independent. Fixed controller selection when an empty gamepad slot appeared before a connected controller. These fixes address reproduced input-recovery defects; they do not change your selected control scheme or saved voyage.

events.title: Better hull collisions and a familiar tutorial market
events.summary: Ships now use rounded hull-shaped collision capsules across sailing, NPC navigation and battles. Rivers retain forgiving clearance so existing routes remain passable. Improved NPC heading consistency and river-detour handling. The tutorial now uses the normal market: sell your fish, see real prices and earnings, undo trades, or return to the city. events.title: More reliable loading and smoother voyages
events.summary: Fixed browser-demo startup on hosts that automatically decompress bitmap-font files. Font integrity checks remain enabled. Reduced unnecessary work when drawing offscreen city shadows and checking water beneath wakes and ship shadows. Road rendering no longer accumulates tiles from earlier parts of a voyage. events.title: A more reliable start
events.summary: The main menu no longer waits for the animated loading artwork to initialize. Startup detects Steam or game-data requests that stop responding and offers Retry instead of leaving “Loading…” on screen indefinitely. Timed-out startup work cannot resume later and overwrite the retry screen or a saved profile. Improved startup diagnostics help identify the stage involved if a launch fails. Fixed a patrol handoff error that could disrupt treasure-pirate routes when saving or restoring the world simulation. Fixed a battle timing error where sinking a ship while a background world update was finishing could interrupt combat and subsequent saves. Each defeated practice canoe gets its own short tip: ramming with your bow, deck fire from archers, crossbowmen and arquebusiers, then completing the encounter. Sailing lesson and controls The tutorial river now follows a chain of hexes with gentle bends, using the same river geometry, water checks and navigation rules as the voyage. events.title: October 1 — practical sailing lessons and consistent handling
events.summary: This update rebuilds the optional sailing lesson around the same handling, controls and feedback used during an ordinary voyage. It also makes early voyages, parcel delivery and market comparisons easier to understand.
